parent_protocol.rule: Everything the parent fixes -- the question, the branches, the level, the read, the bar (the twin null), the prohibitions -- stands unchanged and is not re-litigated.

abort.error: BundleError: outputs row <row id> (request flight-0183): perception-branch receipt is invalid: perception branch candidate_intent_ids must be a non-empty ordered list of distinct non-empty strings (I7v)

counts.failing_stage: FlightRuntime.seal -> bundle outputs validation (I7v, perception-branch receipt)

abort.root_cause: the runner sealed each Perception branch note's candidate intent list verbatim; 61 notes over 49 rows listed one intent twice, and I7v requires a list of distinct intents, so the seal refused rows whose branch notes were legal measured outcomes

fix.rule: receipt schema saea-perception-branch-arms-v2: candidate_intent_ids collapses duplicates (first occurrence kept), candidate_intent_ids_raw_count records the raw length, note_parse_status is ok / duplicates-collapsed / empty / malformed; one shared parser for runner, resume replay and bundle; the level-2 fold carries presentation_skip_reason, contrast_block_sha256 and min_candidates_met; the read treats empty / malformed as gold-absent

rehearsal.where: scratch copy of the attempt (/home/chao/scratch-psv-seal; replay-report.json), fable/psvsealfix code
rehearsal.note: the delivered columns rendered by the fixed seal stage are identical to the live outputs of the flight (delivered-column hash 1f05aee5..., identical on both sides); the presentation outcome of the b-top2contrast branch is a measured outcome, carried through the level-2 fold by the fix

seal_only_completion.mechanism: resume_from the aborted attempt; every row complete in its trace, so is_seal_only; core.flight.cli seal-only seals the 1,080-row manifest under I7r and runs the one official finalize job; zero model contacts, no server, no slot, no lease

resume_replay_proof.gate: scripts/checks/resume_prelaunch_gate_check.py (via scripts/flights/batch/resume_prelaunch_gate.sh) on this cell, re-run by the chain and by the driver's prelaunch on the flight commit
resume_replay_proof.note: Model-free and read-only over the REAL attempt trace: every complete row rendered through the real seal stage under the merged I7v fix (receipt schema saea-perception-branch-arms-v2) and re-checked against I7 / I7n / I7g / I7v one row at a time; no row fails and no sample is sealed twice. The driver's prelaunch replay gate re-runs the same check at launch on the flight commit.
